# Lucide

Lucide 1.58.0, UMD production build, is served locally to avoid runtime requests
to an unpinned third-party script CDN. The npm package SHA-512 integrity was
verified against its registry metadata before extracting the build and license.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide/v/1.58.0

License: `LUCIDE-LICENSE`.
